scope: Kayenta second-edition BASE/CORE, standard 16-round 2–4-player multiplayer, base objective deck; no marked expansion, optional variant or alternate mode.
verdict_detail: Independent source-first challenge found no demonstrated factual error or material requested-part omission in the 62 answer-key entries and no defensible new question under the distinct-rule/outcome-branch criterion. This is a scoped coverage judgment, not a claim that every card number or possible combination has its own test.

input_isolation.french_source_limit: Read only PDF pp7 and14 for Q55. No older flow or seasonal-refresh rule imported.

question_audit.assessment: Twelve ordinary turns and no ordinary turn effects on any courtship are explicit.
Eight-step order and cleanup destinations are correct. Relevant ongoing effects may be resolved in any order; not a material missing outcome branch in the scoped base effects.
Correct pass order and both base passing benefits. Hire on pass is explicitly expansion/optional, so excluded.
The FAQ explicitly freezes screening level before step 3; the four refreshes cost twelve increments and do not invalidate the planned activity.
Positive-before-negative applies to money as well as reputation. Same-activity income and VP cards can cover the penalty.
Costs, repeated Borrow/Help, one paid refresh, affordability and minimum restriction all covered.
Base activity remains available; expanded hiring-when-passing FAQ cannot displace it. Recruitment is common servants only from anywhere on an opponent board.
Conditional housekeeper/footman substitution and unconditional male underbutler substitution distinguished.
Acquisition destination is Expended, not immediately Available. The key correctly covers ordinary rotation and separately enabled earlier availability.
Affordability, price floor, any-means uniqueness and PR acquisition/play distinction correct.
Covers existing and newly drawn duplicate stacks, Reserve diversion and multiple-space ordering.
Seasonal refresh is now default. Corrigendum expressly rejects the incomplete stable-market flow aid.
Ordinary ties have no reputation tiebreak; all tied leaders get VP cards. Objective discard procedure and anticlockwise first-player change correct.
Final scoring aggregates all revealed themes; reputation-level tiebreak and final benefit window correct.
All seven scoring sources and full victory tiebreak covered, including negative VP and wealth rounding.
Standard seven received minus four discarded yields three; extra objective effects add retained capacity.
Immediate-on-draw use is distinct from later own-turn use and correctly retained, including courtship draws.
Mandatory first flip, upgraded permanence, ongoing conversion and perpetual hybrid flip correctly distinguished.
Correct hosting/pass timing, Hall service expenditure and minimum-reputation target immunity.
Three suites have distinct guest sources, service, doubling and permanent state changes; key captures all requested distinctions.
Random first player, draft beginning to the left and all four scoped family bonuses match setup.
Cavendish actual 1.4 start correctly distinguished from common pre-bonus wheel placement; starter tiles and baseline service correct.
source_refs: pp.8–10; lines 314–348,361–364; PDF p.9 starter tile images
Compendium p.9 Family Bonuses, extraction lines346–349: Cavendish advances reputation to level1,position4; source setup common wheel p.8 lines314 before applying bonus.

question_audit.assessment: Three-player hire pool matches setup table; boxed components are unavailable.
Undealt starter guests must rejoin casual deck; no separate in-play type.
Five double-sided monuments with Estate exclusion; activity-to-monument suites remain included separately.
Six different occupied spaces, duplicate stacks, eligibility, orientation and sort correct.
Open first theme, retained earlier themes and correct standard setup.
Each servant moves one space only; unused Available servants remain there.
Event precedes hosting, preventing retroactive Fair income; upgraded reward and standard spaces correct.
source_refs: pp.17,99; lines 650–676,3754–3755; PDF p.12 standard track

question_audit.assessment: Both objectives are kept at event, including on passing turns.
Holiday removes PR screening only; attendance and service remain requirements.
Single unchanged market and no refresh after first purchase explicitly required; Reserve and VP equivalence correct.
Removed tiles cannot recur in that refresh; Reserve remains untouched; replacements sorted.
Level transitions, bounds and interleaved special actions during large favours correct.
Public holdings, no transfer, no unaffordable costs and unlimited supply all supported.
Family can satisfy gender/gentry but not guest-type requirements; exact attendance remains binding.
Ordinary invites reveal new guests; screening reveals kept cards only, rejected cards bottom appropriate deck.
Dismissal is optional, supports current-activity/newly drawn guests and excludes family; ownership/scoring consequences correct.
Ordinary family choices and Asquith both-benefits distinction correct.
Male prestige condition excludes both male casual and female prestige; base Charles qualifies.
Base Fairchild service, favours, prestige status, no PR and return rule correct; no family dismissal immunity.
Correct gossip amounts and owner penalty; neither steals reputation to owner and minimum target immunity applies.
Barn triggers hosting an Estate activity, not ownership or passing.
One Quarters servant per turn is distinct from paid Help and rotation; used servant expends normally.
Private Study front is activity without tile favour; reverse ongoing only.
Main Library changes objective draw to VP card with increased family count; no compensating extra discard.
Objective VP selection and bottom-deck return correct; retained total increases.
All-service immediate refresh distinguished from one Quarters-only Help.
Hire VP uses hire pool, excludes underbutler and puts hire in Expended.
Refresh Guest VP targets any gentry including family in personal discard, immediately reusable.
Base basic-servant objective common-only, unlike all-type regular service VP and ten-servant objective.
Upgraded suites are monuments in their own categories; final hybrid face only.
Base Nature/Domestic values and alternatives checked against Base-labelled entries, excluding Characters replacement values.
Nonfamily guest counting, final Fairchild and complete groups correctly distinguished.
French publisher PDF pp7/14 supports maximum level signalled by Max counter. No older French flow is imported.
source_refs: Official French publisher base rulebook (Super Meeple), PDF pp.7 and14; objective example explicitly maximum reputation level, identified by Max counter; see supplemental-source-provenance.json.

question_audit.assessment: Base upgraded West Terrace remains activity; alternate ongoing back is out of scope.
No hand/discard limit; discard remains owned and scores.
Reserve entirely public and all tiles purchasable, independent of stack order.
Voluntary pass and requirements-failure branches correct. Previously covered refresh/invite tools can make an otherwise short activity legal; key does not forbid those tools.
Only paid special refresh has once-per-turn limit; pass and VP methods remain distinct.
Own-turn restriction and timing anywhere in that turn, including within favour resolution, explicit.
Ordinary invite is mandatory; optional dismissal can be declined. Key appropriately preserves printed may exceptions.

source_coverage.reviewed: All base setup rules, family bonuses, hire pool, monuments, market setup and Alderley Hall setup.
Ordinary rounds, host/pass orders, events, service, favours, cleanup, courtship, seasonal upkeep, final courtship and scoring.
Money, reputation, PR, minimum/maximum, specials, common/unique servants, substitutions, hiring/recruitment. Expansion supplements excluded.
Gentry ownership/types, invites/screening/dismissal, favours, improvement states, monuments/hybrids, market/Reserve and objective/VP procedures.

All FAQ entries assessed for base applicability. Explicit frozen screening reputation, favour ordering/payment, tile objective upgrades, extra objectives and all base market/VP exceptions checked. Expansion/solo-only answers not imported.
Ordinary family cards, base Charles/Elizabeth Fairchild and base gossip cards; marked expansion/promotional guest entries excluded.

Every unmarked base tile entry, both faces, including recurring service abilities, Barn, all suites, hybrids, Private Study, Main Library and base West Terrace. Ordinary changes of numbers/recipes treated as data unless rule mechanism differs.
All VP-card benefits, especially multi-purchase, objective selection, service refresh, guest refresh and hiring destinations.
Every Base-labelled objective, including group alternatives, guest types, categories/hybrids/monuments, common vs all servants, wealth and reputation. Replacement-deck-only objectives excluded.
Read entire PDF. Only market-churn player-aid correction materially affects scoped base rules; other corrections are expansion/solo content.
Max counter is standard level7; objective example requires maximum reputation level as indicated by that counter. Used for Q55 only.

rejected_candidates.candidate: Individual remaining base group, single-tile and servant objective recipes
rejected_candidates.reason: Different tile names, thresholds and VP values repeat the same possession-at-end or count rule. Base-vs-replacement selection and alternative-member groups are already tested; no distinct procedural exception.

rejected_candidates.candidate: A newly bought monument grants reputation immediately on purchase
rejected_candidates.reason: An application of already-tested step order: ongoing step precedes purchasing. No separate acquisition trigger in the core text.

rejected_candidates.candidate: Use a courtship VP-card objective benefit before discarding an objective
rejected_candidates.reason: Combination of immediate-on-draw VP use and courtship discard order already covered by Q13/Q16/Q17/Q47, without a separate source-defined exception.

rejected_candidates.candidate: Use a newly invited guest in the next activity or use a prestige-guest VP card before Invite Gentry
rejected_candidates.reason: Hand addition plus existing invite/turn timing rules; no distinct outcome branch beyond rules already tested.

rejected_candidates.candidate: The same tile completes several retained objectives
rejected_candidates.reason: General score-all-objectives/possession logic; no explicit special exclusivity or priority exception in the scoped sources.

rejected_candidates.candidate: Mandatory penalties on a guest dismissed from the current activity
rejected_candidates.reason: Potentially interesting recombination, but the source does not define a separate dismissal-cancels-favours branch. It should not be invented as a new exception.

rejected_candidates.candidate: Ongoing effects may be resolved in any order
rejected_candidates.reason: Explicit p18 freedom exists, but scoped ongoing effects do not create a meaningful untested negative-own-reputation or mutually-exclusive branch. Q02 already locates all relevant effects after the event. Could clarify wording without expanding the benchmark.

rejected_candidates.candidate: Exact round numbers for Builders’ Holiday or other event restatements
rejected_candidates.reason: Different event-space numbers are data, not a new rule or consequential exception.

rejected_candidates.candidate: Return-gentry favour type restriction using Babbling Brook
rejected_candidates.reason: Babbling Brook is marked Upstairs, Downstairs; outside scope. The base Refresh Guest VP mechanism is already tested by Q50.

rejected_candidates.candidate: Lionheart guest modifier redraws, suite attendance modifiers, promotional guest refusal
rejected_candidates.reason: Source-defined exceptions exist, but affected guest cards and modifiers are marked expansions/promos and excluded. Fixed suite count itself is already tested.

rejected_candidates.candidate: Consecutive passes and hiring on every pass
rejected_candidates.reason: Voluntary/consecutive pass follows Q03/Q59; hiring on pass is expressly excluded from standard base scope.

rejected_candidates.candidate: An otherwise short activity can be rescued with service/guest refresh effects
rejected_candidates.reason: Q04/Q06/Q44/Q48–Q50 already test the relevant distinct mechanisms. Q59 is a fallback legality question, not an assertion that remedies are forbidden.

limitations: No summary or reader performance was inspected, so this report assesses the source/key/question benchmark only.
No expansion/variant exceptions were admitted simply because the integrated compendium discusses them.
No external research was needed or used.
